cases.sentence: Жена одного ученика пророков кричала ___, «Твой слуга, мой муж, умер».
cases.translation: A wife of one of the prophets' disciples cried out to Elisha, saying, 'Your servant, my husband, is dead.'
cases.explain: The dative case is used after the verb кричать (to cry out) with the meaning 'to cry to someone'.

cases.translation: Your servant, my husband, is dead.
cases.explain: Муж is the subject of the verb умер (died), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: У твоей служанки ничего не осталось, лишь горшок ___.
cases.translation: Your servant has nothing in the house except a pot of oil.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with negative constructions and after the noun 'горшок' to show what the pot contains.

cases.sentence: Попроси у соседей пустые ___, да набери их побольше.
cases.translation: Borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don't borrow just a few containers.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used as the direct object of the verb 'попроси' (borrow).

cases.sentence: Запри за собой и за ___ дверь.
cases.translation: Shut the door on yourself and on your sons.
cases.explain: The preposition за (behind/after) governs the instrumental case.
The dative case is used after the preposition в (into) with the meaning 'into'.

cases.sentence: Когда все сосуды наполнились, она сказала ___ дай мне еще один.
cases.translation: When all the containers were full, she said to her son, 'Bring me another container.'
cases.explain: The dative case is used after the verb сказать (to say to someone).

cases.sentence: Она пошла и положила его на постель ___ человека.
cases.translation: She went up and laid him on the man of God's bed.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used to show possession with the adjective Божий.

reading.ru: Он делал зло в глазах Господа, но не так, как его отец и мать, потому что убрал священный камень Баала, который сделал его отец.
reading.question: What evil thing did King Jehoram remove that his father had made?
reading.explain: The text states 'убрал священный камень Баала' — he removed the sacred stone/pillar of Baal.

reading.ru: Елисей ответил ей, «Как мне помочь тебе? Скажи мне, что у тебя есть дома».
reading.question: What question did Elisha ask the widow?
options: How much money do you have?
What do you have in your house?
How many children do you have?
reading.correct: What do you have in your house?
reading.explain: Elisha asked 'что у тебя есть дома' — what she had in her house.

reading.ru: Однажды Елисей отправился в Шунем. Там жила одна богатая женщина, которая уговорила его остаться поесть.
reading.question: What persuaded the wealthy woman to invite Elisha to eat?
options: His previous visits to the region
reading.explain: The text indicates she recognized him as a holy man of God and persuaded him to stay and eat.

reading.ru: Ребенок подрос, однажды он вышел к отцу, который был со жнецами.
reading.question: What was the child's father doing when the child came to him?
reading.explain: The text says the father 'был со жнецами' — was with the reapers.

reading.ru: Она поднялась и положила его на постель Божьего человека, заперла дверь и вышла.
reading.question: What did the Shunammite woman do after her son died?
options: She laid him on the man of God's bed, locked the door and left
reading.correct: She laid him on the man of God's bed, locked the door and left
reading.explain: The text states 'положила его на постель Божьего человека, заперла дверь и вышла'.

reading.ru: Когда Елисей пришел в дом, мальчик лежал мертвым на его постели.
reading.question: Where was the dead child when Elisha entered the house?
reading.explain: The text says 'мальчик лежал мертвым на его постели' — the child lay dead on his bed.
